name: Smartass
source:
You play as a 20-year-old guy who has to find a way out of tough situations, pay for housing, work at not the best and most prestigious jobs, and deal with attacks from detractors. It seems as if the whole world is turning against you. And everything is not in your favor. How will you get through this journey?​

[From Patreon]
